items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled out vs Jaguars, along with Tank Dell and Jalen Pitre.
items.why: Groin injury; team decision not to travel.
items.implication: Full backfield opportunity opens in London game.
items.opportunity: Primary beneficiary is Woody Marks (high snap/touch share in prior absence); stash or start accordingly.

items.text: Jalen Hurts ruled out indefinitely with superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; cannot play until situation resolved. Tanner McKee expected to start.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in clot after he played through it in London; treatment course TBD, blood thinners likely preclude play.
items.implication: Eagles offense shifts to McKee; monitor pass-catcher volumes and any change in Barkley usage if active.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for McKee and potential short-term boost to Eagles WRs/TE if scheme adjusts.

items.text: Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice.
items.why: Ongoing hamstring issues; Smith shows progress.
items.implication: Barkley likely out or limited; Smith trending toward playing. With Hurts out, Dameon Pierce elevated as handcuff.
items.opportunity: Pierce as Barkley handcuff; Smith volume if active vs CAR.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP again Thursday due to hamstring.
items.implication: Questionable trending toward limited or out; Worthy/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs see target bump if out.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially DNP again Thursday (ankle); remains day-to-day with realistic chance to play vs Browns.
items.why: Ankle sprain recovery; coach notes he is working hard.
items.implication: Huntley continues if out; Flowers ceiling impacted without Lamar.
items.opportunity: Monitor Friday/Saturday; Zay Flowers still strong but lower ceiling.

items.text: Caleb Williams full participant second straight day; on track to start Sunday vs Falcons after hamstring absence.
items.why: Full practices in walkthroughs; positive trajectory after three-game miss.
items.implication: Bears offense upgrade; monitor final clearance.
items.opportunity: Boost to Bears pass-catchers like Odunze, Moore, Loveland if he starts.

items.text: Cardinals traded Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans; Kendrick Bourne expected to get open more and earn more targets than MHJ did in ARI.
items.why: Trade fallout analysis by Silva/Levitan; Bourne role expansion in ARI.
items.implication: MHJ debut in HOU London game; ARI WRs (Bourne, Wilson) rise.
items.opportunity: Bourne waiver/upgrade target; MHJ new team opportunity but unknown role.

items.text: Breece Hall remains week-to-week and did not practice; in two full games since injury Braelon Allen played 90 snaps, Isaiah Davis 12.
items.why: Snap data shows Allen dominating committee in Hall's absence.
items.implication: Allen is clear lead back while Hall out; Hall not imminent return.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen as must-start/handcuff priority; Davis minimal.

items.text: Jaylen Warren monster day/usage as Rico Dowdle return looms but Dowdle has lost job/role; Warren has most total yards in any three-game stretch.
items.why: Elite production and snaps while Dowdle limited/returning from toe.
items.implication: Warren locked as RB1; Dowdle to One Injury Away/handcuff only.
items.opportunity: Warren every-week starter; Dowdle droppable in shallower leagues.

items.text: Despite Hurts out after waivers, Berry likes Tanner McKee as the fill-in starter for Eagles.
items.why: Positive on McKee opportunity in Eagles offense vs CAR.
items.implication: Viable streamer QB if needed; supports Eagles skill players.
items.opportunity: McKee streaming consideration; Goedert/others maintain value.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty said he is feeling great and this is the best he has felt this season.
items.why: Player comments on feeling best of season after ankle issues.
items.implication: Clear for full workload vs Bills likely.
items.opportunity: Strong start candidate; full role expected.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans as WR4 this week vs Commanders secondary; all-in on the matchup and target share with Deebo out longer.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass catchers; Evans season-high target share recently and Deebo multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: High target share expected; start with confidence.

items.text: Berry loves Drake London (WR6 vs CHI) for bankable usage and Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI) for elite recent usage vs leaky run D; also Javonte Williams and Rhamondre Stevenson.
items.why: Volume + favorable matchups; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line, Stevenson volume with Henderson out multi-weeks, London consistent role.
items.opportunity: Prioritize these in lineups for volume/matchup.

items.text: Berry hates Jaylen Waddle (ugly matchup/low production outside one game), Bo Nix (toughest pass D, playing scared), Justin Herbert (scoring rut, low total), Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts, JK Dobbins.
items.why: Matchup/QB issues for Waddle/Egbuka/Pitts; Nix vs elite pass D and reduced deep shots; Herbert low totals; Dobbins tough run D.
items.implication: Fade or sit these this week.
items.opportunity: Avoid in starts; look for better options.
